description: Fall has arrived, pumpkins are out and voting season is just around the corner! There is a lot going on in October, so here is a quick rundown of all the events you might want to visit. Oct. 3 - Paynesville Homecoming 1-3 pm Laborers and Farmers Rally St. Charles Oct. 4 - Callaway County Dems BBQ - Memorial Park 4 -6 pm Oct. 8 - NAACP Forum in Fulton Oct. 10 - Clarksville ApplefestOct. 16 - Fulton Homecoming Oct. 17 - Louisiana Colorfest Oct. 21 - Lincoln University Town Hall Oct. 22 - Montgom
title: Fall Season
